name: Swami Vivekanand Scholarship for Technical Diploma in Professional Courses
benefit: - A monthly stipend of ₹400 for 12 months for the ITI and professional courses.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant should be a student. 1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Tribe (ST) category. 1. The applicant should be enrolled in a state government industrial training institute (ITI), or a government-recognized Private ITI, or a recognized one-year professional course. 1. The applicant’s family annual income should not exceed ₹1,20,000 in rural areas. 1. The applicant’s family annual income should not exceed ₹1,50,000 in urban areas.
